findings.text: the prior review's finding stands at this head — the published claim's pre-spawn shape (no pid, phase "starting") is stated as load-bearing by the writer's docstring (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1110) and held by no assertion: measured, a plugin wrapping `_publish_launch_claim` so the claim record gains the composing process's live pid left all five cases green (5 passed, exit 0, the probe receipt listing the seven claims it rewrote), while the shape change flips what a claims reader reports from "records no worker process yet" (reckon/crew/claims.py:251-255) to "its worker is still running as pid N"; the case added at this revision (line 285) already holds the claim in flight and is where one assertion on the record's keys and phase would pin it.

justifications.durability: the added cases fail if the early publication regresses — measured, they redden at base 3be868de (3 failed, the two held-claim assertions reading [] and the mid-launch claim DID NOT RAISE) — but the assertion that would pin the published claim's pre-spawn shape is still absent, so the shape that a claims reader depends on is held by no guard — the measurement is on the FINDING line.
justifications.evidence: the two-arm gate and the re-run control are recorded in logs whose headers name the imported module per arm (gate-head-suite.log, gate-base-suite.log, negative-control-addition.log under ~/.cache/reckon-launch-claim/), and my own arms at 207553ce and 3be868de reproduce the head green and the three base reds with the imported dispatch asserted inside each tree.
justifications.fit: the new names state their mechanism (`_publish_launch_claim`, `_release_launch_claim`, `_claim_released_on_refusal`, exclude_run_ids) and the added docstrings at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1100-1116 state the shape and its reason rather than the task, matching the surrounding module's idiom.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the claim is visible to a peer for the whole pre-spawn span (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3839) and the self-refusal is impossible by construction (:3857, :4328), with one residue checked rather than scored as a gap: an interrupt (BaseException, which the guard at :3852 does not catch) inside the widened span strands a binding pid-less claim, exactly as the earlier revision's launch guard already did, and `reckon crew discard --run <id>` (reckon/cli.py:3994) removes it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 3be868de 207553ce lists six changed paths, all inside the five the manifest declares, and the large dispatch.py delta is the preflight block moving under the guard plus the exclusion parameter rather than unrelated work.
